# env/requirements-env.txt - the simulator stack for env/env_demo.py (the MuJoCo three-block scene of the project).
# Install into the same Python 3.10 venv as requirements.txt, in ONE pip call:
#     pip install -r requirements.txt -r env/requirements-env.txt
# (requirements.txt alone pulls gymnasium 1.4.0 through stable-pretraining; this file pins 1.3.0, so installing the
# two files one after the other prints an "Uninstalling gymnasium-1.4.0" downgrade - expected and harmless; the
# one-pass install resolves both at once.)
# torch, torchvision, numpy, pillow, hydra-core, einops, typer, rich, tabulate, scipy are already pinned in
# requirements.txt and are also hard dependencies of the packages below. The versions are the ones of the simulation
# venv the scene was collected with and this demo was verified in (importlib.metadata of that venv; see RUNNING.md 9).
mujoco==3.11.0
ogbench==1.2.1
# stable-worldmodel: the GIT COMMIT, not the PyPI 0.1.1 release (which is the earlier commit 15a5538 of the same
# package); do not add its [env] extra (it drags ale-py / craftax / stable-baselines3, none of which is needed).
stable-worldmodel @ git+https://github.com/galilai-group/stable-worldmodel.git@4821c8e6a3f0f83b7e6a80da3a757e026ea9026b
dm_control==1.0.44
gymnasium==1.3.0
pygame==2.6.1
pymunk==7.3.0
shapely==2.1.2
glfw==2.10.2
PyOpenGL==3.1.10
tqdm==4.70.1
absl-py==2.5.0
lxml==6.1.3
dm-tree==0.1.10
# transitive, left to pip: dm-env, labmaze, protobuf, pyparsing, requests, etils[epath], setuptools (dm_control);
# gymnasium[mujoco] extras (ogbench).
#
# Rendering backend (environment variable MUJOCO_GL, read when mujoco is imported; env_demo.py sets it from --gl when
# given, otherwise keeps an exported value and defaults to egl):
#   egl    - headless, needs a GPU driver that exposes EGL (used for the verified runs: WSL2 + NVIDIA driver);
#   glfw   - needs a display (WSLg / X11 / macOS / Windows); the project's own data collection used
#            MUJOCO_GL=glfw GALLIUM_DRIVER=d3d12 MESA_D3D12_DEFAULT_ADAPTER_NAME=NVIDIA LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib on WSL2;
#   osmesa - CPU Mesa (needs the system libosmesa6 / mesa libraries), headless anywhere, slow.
# Measured here: egl vs glfw+d3d12 frames differ by <= 9 of 255 on 1.1 % of the 224-px pixel values (physics identical);
# the tilt read-out moves by <= 0.21 deg on real latents, <= 0.66 deg on predicted ones (RUNNING.md 9.4).
